statement: Linux probes B2 A1 user-calibration markers; missing/invalid user magic falls back to factory addresses. Missing SPI reply or implausible factory/user stick centers causes constants center=2000, min=500, max=3500. IMU read failures use default offset/scale, while a successful all-0xFF IMU payload is not separately checked by this parser and may yield invalid units even with divisor protection.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: hid-nintendo.c 1080-1215, 1244-1317. No observed retail failure handling; repeated uninitialized SPI values remain a potential calibration hazard.
